author: Independent AI software reviewer state lane
scope: Original fictional software/browser challenges only; no human or physical-device validation. No runner drafted before implementation checkpoint.

cases.setup: Pure API: construct tracker from emptyRecord copy A. Mutate A.work after construction. Capture B with work="Fictional lantern inventory", kind="download"; mutate B.work afterward. Mutate a checkpointValue result if mutable.
cases.expected: Initial and captured checkpoints remain independent of caller mutations. Initial kind is initial. Captured kind is download. hasChanges uses exact string equality.

cases.setup: Pure API: checkpoint work="Lamp A\r\nLamp B\rLamp C\n"; compare against LF-only variant, trailing-space variant and exact original. Capture several kinds then query kind and values.
cases.expected: Only exact original is unchanged. Ordinary string differences remain changes. Kind and checkpointValue match latest capture.

cases.setup: Start defaults. Change work to "Fictional archive label sorting" and revert empty; select evidenceType="Fictional exercise" then return default; set decisionDate="2026-11-07" then clear. Use input-only and change-only dispatch paths separately.
cases.expected: Every departure marks changes and every complete revert clears changes. Only 28 note fields remain. No approval, verification or safe guarantee follows.

cases.setup: Reopen valid draft with work="Copper\r\nTin\rZinc\n", owner="Fictional stores role". Change owner, save JSON and inspect bytes; then edit work to unrelated string, return to its original visible LF text and restore owner. Save again.
cases.expected: Untouched imported work stays exact through unrelated edits. Return to original displayed work restores exact original mixed endings. Full revert clears changed state. JSON exports preserve original exact value.

cases.setup: Dirty work="Fictional beacon list version A". During synchronous anchor click for JSON download, change work to version B and dispatch input. Capture generated Blob separately.
cases.expected: Blob contains version A. Download checkpoint is A. Version B remains changed and warns on leave. Returning to A clears change state. Status says requested, not retained or verified.

cases.setup: Dirty work="Fictional amber catalogue". Independently inject synchronous URL.createObjectURL throw and anchor click throw. Save JSON. Then change to initial value.
cases.expected: Each failure retains prior checkpoint and notes; dirty stays dirty until actual revert. Failure messaging does not claim saved. No checkpoint movement merely because Blob was produced.

cases.setup: Dirty work="Fictional marsh map". Export text successfully, preview notes, then inject synchronous download error and export text again.
cases.expected: Neither successful text export nor preview nor failed text export changes JSON checkpoint. Failed text export exposes copyable preview and preserves notes; status remains changed.

cases.setup: Dirty work="Fictional quay tags" with preview open and evidence selection set. Start delayed valid import; while pending change work to another value and return it to same visible pre-read value. Resolve import.
cases.expected: Existing revision race protection rejects import even when net strings return. Current notes, preview, selections and checkpoint survive. Picker re-enables. Pending read itself never clears changed state.

cases.setup: Dirty work="Fictional fern register". Start delayed valid import while retaining current controls. Save current JSON while read pending, then reject delayed read.
cases.expected: Successful download establishes current exact checkpoint; later failed read does not move it. File status failure cannot turn saved checkpoint dirty or replace notes. Subsequent edit becomes changed.

cases.setup: Dirty work="Fictional ridge route". Try malformed JSON, invalid UTF-8, oversized advertised file, rejected arrayBuffer, file selection with no file, cancelled replacement of valid draft.
cases.expected: All preserve notes and prior checkpoint. Initial/unchanged state stays unchanged if invalid import attempted there too. Successful reopen only after confirmed replacement establishes checkpoint and clears changed state.

cases.setup: Reopen valid draft with fiction plus self-reported choices and a date, modify work. Cancel clear, then confirm clear. Edit fresh work and return empty.
cases.expected: Cancel preserves everything including dirty tracking and preview. Confirm resets to 28 defaults, hides preview and sets clear checkpoint. Fresh edits and revert use defaults, never reopened draft.

cases.setup: Reopen mixed-ending draft. Without input/change events restore work control to a different string plus evidence select and date. Dispatch pageshow. Then restore all visible controls to original displayed values and pageshow again.
cases.expected: Restored values reconcile into notes and tracking. Departure marks changes, complete revert clears. Unchanged mixed endings remain exact. Selection helper stays consistent with actual restored control.

cases.setup: Observe changes-status mutations. Make first dirty edit, then multiple further keystrokes while dirty, revert, change select using change event, save JSON, edit again. Monitor beforeunload registrations/removals and synthetic cancelable event behavior.
cases.expected: Role=status present. No status mutation on every keystroke when boolean state unchanged. Native beforeunload attached only dirty, removed clean. Standard preventDefault/returnValue behavior with no custom approval copy.

cases.setup: Inspect new status/messages and privacy claims before/after reopen, save, clear; inject arbitrary self-reported positive readiness and human decision choices.
cases.expected: States describe changes relative to checkpoint. No guarantee of disk retention or native warning reliability, no approval/verification/V2 claim. No persistence or automatic download is added. Positive user choices cannot alter warning semantics.
